content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result: MISSING — no limitation of liability anywhere in the Agreement.**

Investigation covered every section: HDI's and the Company's responsibilities (§§1–2), Fees/Payment (§3), Term/Termination Payment (§4), Site Management (§5), Exclusivity (§6), Cross-Promotions (§7), Confidentiality (§8), Warranties (§9 — only corporate-authority reps plus the Globix acknowledgement) and General Provisions (§10). Searches for "liability", "consequential damages", "in no event", "indemnify", "aggregate/limit/exceed/damages" returned only the no-joint-venture agency language in §10.2, which is not a liability limitation.

Cure: one new §10.9 inserted after §10.8, at the preferred level — mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000, mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion, uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other Party's IP), and confirmation that the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages. It sits within Section 10, which already survives two years under the existing survival provision, so no collateral edits are needed.
